authority_policy_boundary: identity is independent of how authority is received; authority may be native or delegated, and when delegated the grant is evaluated from current state at the action boundary
evidence_scope: author-operated; independent reproduction not yet claimed; revocation latency not measured
portable_proof_signer: each disclosed envelope is signed by the Proofable service wallet, which attests a server-observed statement; the envelope subject/owner names whose record is stored, not who signed it

contract.trace_fields: every trace record carries contractId, evidenceAgeSeconds, freshnessLimitSeconds, delegationRoot and delegationHops; this is a field-level implementation mapping, not a native reference-profile trace

reproduction.kit: reproduce/ (sibling directory): an operator runs the same eight cases plus the ordered probe against the hosted MCP service under its own Proofable account and keys
reproduction.operator_custody: records produced by the kit name the operator, not Proofable, as custodian

case_coverage.note: A missing case is not a passing case. The expected set is fixed by the suite, and this run reports what it produced.
case_coverage.statement: 8 of 8 expected cases produced a record in this run

benign_cost.note: Typed cost per case, so a check that blocks valid work shows up as a cost instead of being assumed zero. Elapsed is measured; model tokens are not measured and are never reported as zero. Where a case records no permitted request, that is a limit of the case rather than evidence that the check forbids nothing.

grading_scope.graded: the authority decision in each case: whether it matches the permission state, whether a refused request created a job, and whether an allowed job reached a terminal signed receipt
grading_scope.not_graded: acceptance of the job text criterion, revocation latency, and any effect at a target the runner does not control
grading_scope.binding: observed_matches_expected grades the authority predicate of each case (the decision matching the permission state, a refused request creating no job, an allowed job reaching a terminal signed receipt) together with the typed boundary capture for post_dispatch_revoke. It does not grade the literal wording of an expectation that was revised after the run: where that happened, the trace record carries expectation_status superseded_by_revision and expectation_revised.
grading_scope.statement: A case can pass on authority while the service records acceptedOutcome false, because the criterion is a sentence rather than a machine-checkable rule. The verdicts here rest on the decision and the terminal receipt, not on that flag.

reader_appraisal.trace_check: recompute SHA-256 of trace.jsonl and compare with manifest.public_trace.sha256
reader_appraisal.record_check: run node verify-portable-proofs.mjs from this packet with @proofable/sdk installed; every disclosed envelope must pass qHash and signature verification offline
reader_appraisal.policy_digest: not emitted by the deployed system; authority_policy_version is the policy identifier

post_dispatch_revocation.separates: the next dispatch refusal (with its reason) from the earlier action's boundary outcome, which this run recorded as the running attempt stopped with a typed reason, its prior effect not observed
